subject: Delegate SIG steward + short-lived upload workflow
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.io>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: short-lived upload + SIG steward for Acme profile

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier this week. We are ready to move the Acme profile on Vendr from 'owner: Acme-Security' to a delegated SIG steward model so we can give our vendor managers short-lived upload access for evidence (SOC 2/CAIQ) without widening long-term permissions.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood create a minimal delegation/artifact that shows who the steward will be and the scope (SIG controls only, upload-role only)? We need something to attach to our procurement package.
2) We need a short-lived onboarding flow for temporary upload accounts (TTL ~24h presigned links or ephemeral credentials). What are your recommendations and what evidence (logs / timestamps) do you emit for compliance review?

Cc'd Vendr support to confirm whether the platform supports ephemeral presign windows tied to delegated stewards, and what audit logs are available.

Appreciate a quick outline and any sample artifact we can include in our intake.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Lead InfoSec Manager — Acme Cloud

Attachments: none
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>, Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 17:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: short-lived upload + SIG steward for Acme profile

Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. High level plan and what we'll deliver:

1) SIG steward delegation artifact (what you can attach to procurement)
   - We will draft a short one-page delegation letter that names the Redwood-assigned steward, the scope (SIG/CAIQ controls only), and the delegated actions (upload, tag, remove upload).
   - The artifact will list mapping to CAIQ control IDs that the steward will manage (example: IA-01, DS-03 — full mapping in the doc).

2) Temporary upload workflow and audit evidence
   - We recommend ephemeral presigned uploads with 24-hour TTL. Vendr/our platform will record: presign request timestamp, uploader identity (steward or delegated user id), file hash, and final ingestion event with S3 object key and ingestion timestamp.
   - We can export a trimmed evidence bundle (CSV + JSON of events) that you can attach to your SOC 2/procurement packet.

3) What we need from Acme (quick list)
   - Confirm steward identity (name + email) or allow Redwood to assign (we can make an RBAC account for 'acme-sig-steward@redwoodinference.com' for short-term use).
   - Confirm whether 24h TTL is acceptable; if you need <24h we can propose 6h windows.
   - Any CAIQ controls you want prioritized for immediate ingestion (we'll start with the top 25 controls you flagged in intake).

Jordan — can you own preparing the draft delegation artifact and the event-export template? Kimberly, please review the template for audit completeness and retention notes.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Draft delegation letter (word doc) — 24 business hours (Jordan)
- Temporary upload onboarding PDF with step-by-step & sample logs — 48 business hours (Jordan/Kimberly)
- Example event export for Acme (sample CSV + hash list) — included in onboarding PDF

Sarah — once we have your confirmation on steward identity and TTL, we'll attach the delegation doc and send the onboarding package to Vendr for the presign setup.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Partner Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-corp.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: short-lived upload + SIG steward for Acme profile

Markus / Sarah / Vendr team — quick update and attachments.

I have prepared the draft delegation letter and a compact onboarding guide for temporary uploads. Both are attached as stubs here. Highlights:
- Delegation letter names: "Acme Vendor Managers (delegated)" as the upload role; steward = acme-sig-steward@redwoodinference.com (Redwood-managed). We keep the steward as an accountable role and the vendor managers as delegated uploaders.
- Onboarding doc includes: presign TTL options (6h/24h), minimum file-hash logging, and a sample CSV event export (columns: event_time, presign_requestor, uploader_id, s3_key, sha256, ingest_time).
- Retention note: we keep event logs for 90 days by default; longer retention can be requested and exported for your SOC 2 evidence bucket.

Attachments (included):
- SIG-steward-delegation.docx (delegation letter template)
- temporary-upload-onboarding.pdf (step-by-step + sample exports)

Next steps for Acme: confirm steward email or say 'Redwood assign' and pick TTL.

Vendr support — when you get a chance, can you confirm that the Acme profile can accept a Redwood-managed steward account with presign policies bound to that account? Also, what audit log retention is configurable on the Vendr side vs. what Redwood must capture?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Security Programs — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-steward-delegation.docx (Word doc, 38 KB), temporary-upload-onboarding.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)
